verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an error-tracking and monitoring platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Honeybadger's hosted service, such as errors sent to its API at api.honeybadger.io and a hosted MCP server, and never mentions a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product.
